text:
Marta (AE): FYI asking approval for SparrowPay. They hit a big one-off integration run and May invoice is $14,600. Sales asking for a special pricing concession: convert $6,000 of the overage into a performance rebate if they agree to a 4-month dedicated pilot.

Evan (Finance): Need invoice split and whether rebate is conditional on signed pilot. also: how to treat for revenue recognition (amortize vs immediate contra)?

Marta (AE): Split below (rounded):
```
- Gen tokens: $7,900
- Embeddings: $3,200
- Integration engineering hours billed: $1,800
- Data egress infra surge: $1,700
- TOTAL: $14,600
Proposal: $6,000 rebate applied as $2k credit across next 3 invoices if they sign 4-month pilot (min $3.5k/mo). Rebate void if they cancel pilot early.
```

Priya (RevOps): For forecasting treat as contra-revenue and amortize across the credit months. Also suggest we cap finance exposure at $5,000 and require pilot addendum executed before issuing any credit.

Evan (Finance): I can approve up to $5,000 conditional on: 1) signed 4-month pilot addendum (uploaded to S3), 2) rebate amortized over the 3 invoices, 3) GL account "special_rebates_may", and 4) legal-approved clawback if they cancel within 30 days.

Marta (AE): Sales is fine with the $5k cap and will push for signature today. They wont ask for SLA changes, just the rebate.

Sam (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment with rebate schedule and clawback. Recommend language: rebate is forfeited if pilot terminated early or customer invoices go unpaid for 2 consecutive cycles. Will route for countersign.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-420 (amount: $5,000) \u0002status: pending finance approval and legal countersign.\n
Evan (Finance): Final: conditional approval $5k. Billing, hold issuance until signed addendum uploaded and legal confirms. Priya, please flag in CRM and block auto-churn triggers during pilot.

Priya (RevOps): Will add flags and renewal task. Marta, ping when signed and Ill move the credit to billing queue. :white_check_mark:
